description_full: Dave & Buster's Entertainment, Inc. owns and operates entertainment and dining venues for adults and families in North America. Its venues offer a menu of entrées and appetizers, as well as a selection of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages; and an assortment of entertainment attractions centered on playing games and watching live sports, and other televised events. The company also provides food, drinks, and entertainment, including bowling, laser tag, arcade games, and virtual reality. The company operates its venues under the Dave & Buster's and Main Event brands. Dave & Buster's Entertainment, Inc. was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Coppell, Texas.

financial_summary: Dave & Buster's Entertainment,  is a micro-cap communication services business with a $279M market cap on $2.1B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +17% over the past three years and +9% annually across the full decade, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at 16% against a 9% cost of capital, a 7-point spread that creates value, though narrow enough that competitive pressure could close it.
The company is burning through $101M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, debt is heavy at 4.1× net debt/EBITDA, and leverage like that is what turns a bad year into a permanent loss, and thin 0.6× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Management returns a meaningful 8.6% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insiders hold 5.1% of the shares, and profit capture is only 0.2× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
